ios.desc:
Step into the cockpit of Atlas Fury, a fast-paced space shooter that combines classic arcade action with modern gameplay. Inspired by Tyrian and Space Invaders, this game tests your reflexes and strategy as you face endless waves of cosmic enemies. Whether you're a fan of bullet hell, retro space games or arcade-style fun, Atlas Fury offers it all. Dodge, shoot and power up in various intense game modes. This isn’t your typical roguelike or survivor-style game it’s pure arcade adrenaline!

KEY FEATURES

New Xtreme Mode: Push your skills to the limit with this challenging mode.
10 Survival Levels + 5 Endless Levels: How long can you survive the escalating cosmic threat?
Random Events: Enhance your ship or face greater challenges with dynamic events.
Achievements: Unlock a variety of achievements by defeating enemies and completing objectives.
19 Unique Ships: Choose from ships with distinct weapons, effects and play styles.
SURGE Power-Up: Unleash invincible power and wreak havoc on your foes!
6 Special Weapons: Earn powerful new weapons after a 50-kill streak with chest power-ups.
Level Up System: Collect gems and power-ups to upgrade your ship and survive longer.
Engaging Chatter: Enjoy comical banter between you and enemies during intense battles.

Arcade Action Like Never Before Atlas Fury delivers fast-paced, old-school arcade thrills like Tyrian, Space Invaders and Galaga. Whether you’re chasing high scores or honing your skills, the action never stops. With every level, enemies become more powerful, demanding quick reflexes and smart upgrades.

A Game for True Space Shooter Fans Unlike bullet heavens or roguelites, Atlas Fury sticks to pure arcade shooter roots. Dodge waves of enemies, make split-second decisions and unleash devastating attacks, all while racking up kills and powering up your ship. It’s the perfect pick-up-and-play game for retro gaming enthusiasts or anyone seeking an exciting space combat challenge.

What's Up in Atlas Fury?

Xtreme Mode: Start at level 11 and face the toughest enemies and levels yet.
19 Customizable Ships: Each ship has unique weapons and strengths for endless strategies.
Random Events: Collect Gems to upgrade your ship and adapt to ever-changing events that can shift the battlefield.
Retro Power-Ups: Collect chest power-ups to unlock special abilities that act like supercharged weapons.
